name: Sanctuary

objects.text: Rubble over the arch. Behind it, water drips: the Tide Gallery. PATCH: "I'm working on a fix."
A dead CRT set into the stone, glowing faint blue. PATCH: "Don't lick it."
Another CRT stone. Someone scratched a tally into it: four lines, one slash.
Callum's bedroll, a bestiary under the pillow. You rest a while. The team's patched up.
Nolan's bedroll, folded with corners you could cut yourself on. You rest a while. The team's patched up.
Haydon's bedroll, a phone propped up, still streaming to nobody. You rest a while. The team's patched up.
Dani's bedroll, still rolled up. He hasn't got here yet. You rest a while. The team's patched up.
